page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance powered by a dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Built on KVM hypervisor architecture, this instance offers 16 vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The memory system provides 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio (4.0 GB per core). Cache allocation includes 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 33 MB shared L3 cache per socket. The CPU instruction set features AVX, AVX-512, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA capabilities. The instance includes 7 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates with no local disk storage, and contains no discrete GPU hardware.

Benchmark results reveal a clear distinction between single-threaded and parallel processing capabilities on the ecs.g5ne.4xlarge. Single-core performance falls into lower tiers, evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1106.79, a Geekbench single-core score of 949.0, and a gzip compression throughput of 19.02 GB/sec. However, multi-core scaling yields average performance metrics across workloads, demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 11738.07, a Geekbench multi-core score of 5846.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 12950.69. Application tests show steady mid-tier execution with 11.72 million operations per second in Redis SET tasks, 7.75 GB/sec static web serving throughput, and 815.98 tokens/sec prompt processing on 135M parameter LLM models.

From a hardware class perspective, the instance provides steady resource density for general computing workloads that leverage parallel CPU processing rather than peak single-core clock speeds. The primary tradeoff lies in the absence of bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent data, alongside lower single-threaded processing speeds. Consequently, the ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is best suited for multi-threaded microservices, static web serving, Redis caching tiers, software compilation tasks, and moderate-scale application backends rather than heavy single-threaded computational jobs or large-scale AI model inference.
